text:
sam_sandbar: Hey CS — we just closed the Sandbar deal. They want to onboard a custom 7B LLM trained on transaction + support logs, including limited PHI. Asking for Private deployment (VPC) + HSM for keys. Timeline: want prod in 8 weeks. Can we triage risks and renewal impact?

emily_cs: congrats! quick q — is Sandbar shipping training data to us or hosting and providing read-only access?

sam_sandbar: They will provide an SFTP export and also want inference in our VPC. Data includes customer names + masked SSNs in some records. They want assurances on retention and audit logging.

emily_cs: ok noted. two tracks: security/legal for PHI/HSM + infra for private deploy. i'll loop in infra and research for eval plan.

jordan_infra: @emily_cs we can do VPC + private control plane. HSM integration: we support AWS KMS and external HSM via PKCS11 — need customer certs and network allowlist. timeline depends on onboarding window for HSM (~1-2 weeks) and capacity reservations.

lee_research: for the evals we should run: 1) safety regression on our PHI detector, 2) hallucination tests on domain prompts, 3) latency/cost bench on 7B quantized profile. also need test prompt set from Sandbar (50-100 prompts).

sam_sandbar: i'll get the prompt set and a redacted sample dataset. we also need a canary rollout + automatic fallback to hosted small model during spikes. renewal is tied to SLA: they asked about <150ms token p50 for short replies — is that realistic in private?

jordan_infra: <150ms p50 is aggressive for a 7B in private unless pinned on pinned GPUs + optimized batching. we can present options: Dedicated with reserved capacity for p50 SLA or Private with best-effort latency + routing to Dedicated during peak.

emily_cs: action items: (1) sam to share prompt set + redacted sample (ETA 3 days), (2) jordan to sketch infra options + rough cost delta (2 business days), (3) lee to draft eval matrix + safety checklist (3 business days). i'll own the renewal risk memo for the AE.

onboard-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.example.com/onboard-playbooks/sandbar-1765004321 — includes PHI intake form, HSM cert template, and eval template. Please mark completed items in the checklist. :white_check_mark:

sam_sandbar: thanks — i'm uploading the redacted sample now (shared drive link). also FYI they require quarterly attestation reports on key access.

lee_research: noted. we'll include attestation cadence in the compliance section of the eval. also will add a PHI-specific stress test to the eval harness.

emily_cs: flagged renewal risk: price sensitivity on dedicated capacity. i'll propose a pilot discounted commit for first 6 months and track usage via token-level dashboards.

jordan_infra: last note — if they insist on on-prem HSM (no cloud KMS), lead time is +3 weeks and pre-scheduled on-prem install required. call out in the AE memo.

emily_cs: great. i'll draft the customer kickoff note and cc legal/security. Sam, expect a follow-up with task owners and timeline tomorrow. :thumbsup:
